contract.rule: Every generated proposal resolves its active primitive through the canonical primitive authority before admission
The evaluator accepts only MappingResult objects backed by an explicit mapping identity and contract hash
Survivor ordering consumes the frozen strict-feasibility tuple and never the legacy zero-cost gross proxy
Only mechanically fixed legal proposal coordinates and exact closure-tag code may enter legacy parity; performance fields cannot select them
Capability qualification cannot activate formal performance search
Capability qualification cannot integrate or activate a new data release
Capability qualification cannot open forward, challenge, recent, May stress, promotion, or cross-sprint memory boundaries
Sealed or spent evaluation roles may produce audit reports but may not enter candidate feedback, search, memory, scheduling, or promotion

contracts.rule: The annotated closure tag and committed closure manifest own CURRENT_DATA_UNDERPOWERED and HOLD_RESEARCH
Architecture completion or development evidence is not OOS proof and cannot authorize promotion

nodes.label: Accepted Frontier closure and economic decision

contracts.rule: CRYPTO_SEARCH_INSTRUMENT_MISMATCH_CONFIRMED is a bounded static and development-evidence conclusion, not proof that alpha is absent or data is the unique bottleneck
ForecastArtifact and PortfolioArtifact retain their native learner, mapping, and evaluator semantics before bridge comparison
The common bridge is one-day delayed with 5 bps L1-turnover cost and cannot replace native evidence or imply OOS qualification
A paradigm that fails predeclared dates, samples, assets, coverage, variance, history, label, turnover, or independent-block minima is DATA_ADEQUACY_UNDERPOWERED and cannot enter a large experiment
A new release requires ingress preflight and content-hash-bound observed facts; at most two matched external paradigms plus baseline may run, otherwise NO_LARGE_EXPERIMENT
This path owns only fixed finite-grammar synthetic capability qualification; it does not own economic research or historical Epoch execution
A capability PASS cannot start real development search, open sealed roles, integrate data, promote a candidate, or write cross-sprint memory
Historical B1S/Epoch implementations may supply fixed proposal or parity evidence but cannot own primitive semantics, mapping, feedback, survivor, or lifecycle authority
Each active primitive_id has exactly one canonical mathematical semantics and implementation; source-qualified legacy aliases cannot silently override it
A candidate must carry a supported portfolio_mapping_id and content-hashed mapping contract before entering the capability evaluator
Wrong lag, missing mapping, illegal proposals, non-finite strict metrics, and non-canonical primitive authority fail closed before survivor ordering
NEW_PERFORMANCE_SEARCH_FROZEN remains in force; synthetic qualification cannot activate a real market search
NO_NEW_DATA_INTEGRATION remains in force; this repair consumes no new release and cannot activate one
Validation, test, recent, May stress, forward, and challenge roles are report-only or sealed and cannot feed search, ranking, scheduling, memory, or promotion
Candidate promotion and cross-sprint adaptive memory remain forbidden; separate CURRENT nodes retain the performance-search and new-data boundaries
Only explicit user authorization and an accepted non-stale decision may change a sealed lifecycle state
